question: Cheryl counted 16 lemons. Lori bought 28 more lemons. How many lemons do the girls have altogether?
Coach Mike bought several cups of lemonade. The girls told him it would cost 58 cents. The coach gave the girls 75 cents. How much change did Coach Mike get back?
Scott and Sam decided to sell their old comic books. They had 90 comic books altogether. After the sale, they only had 25 comic books. How many comic books did Scott and Sam sell?
Frankie and Max went trick-or-treating. Frankie got 74 pieces of candy. Max got 92 pieces of candy. How many more pieces of candy did Max get?
Terry and Grace are building a gear machine. Terry used 37 building pieces. Grace used 45 pieces. How many building pieces did they use altogether?
Angela won a contest. She gets $90 to spend at Puzzle Palace. She bought many wonderful puzzles. She had $12 left. How much did she spend?
35 people visited the Statue of Liberty in the morning. 56 more people visited in the afternoon than in the morning. How many people visited the Statue of Liberty in the afternoon?
Chris has 18 soccer cards. His friend, Charlie, has 32 cards. How many fewer cards does Chris have?
Matthew and Billie went apple picking. Matthew found 46 big, red apples. Billie found some as well. Together they found 80 apples. How many apples did Billie find?
35 campers went rowing in the morning. 27 campers went rowing in the afternoon. How many campers went rowing in all?
The library has 75 science books. The second graders borrowed 18 of them. How many science books are left?
Frannie and Meg are in a jump rope contest. Frannie jumped 53 times without missing. She jumped 18 fewer times than Meg. How many times did Meg jump?
The difference between two numbers is 24. The smaller number is 46. What is the larger number?
If you add 45 to a mystery number you will get 92. What is the mystery number?
Sam and Erica have $91 together. Sam has $38. How does Erica have?
Wendy bought 84 inches of ribbon. She used 46 inches to wrap presents. How much ribbon did Wendy have left?
Marco and his dad went strawberry picking. Together their strawberries weighed 23 pounds. Marco's strawberries weighed 14 pounds. How much did his dad's strawberries weigh?

The Wholesome Bakery baked 5 loaves of bread on Wednesday, 7 loaves of bread on Thursday, 10 loaves of bread on Friday, 14 loaves of bread on Saturday, and 19 loaves of bread on Sunday. If this pattern continues, how many loaves of bread will they bake on Monday?

Austin is putting stickers in a sticker book. He put 8 stickers on the first page, 16 stickers on the second page, 24 stickers on the third page, and 32 stickers on the fourth page. If this pattern continues, how many stickers will Austin put on the fifth page?

Sandra is sorting pencils into boxes. She put 78 pencils in the first box, 87 pencils in the second box, 96 pencils in the third box, and 105 pencils in the fourth box. If this pattern continues, how many pencils will Sandra put in the fifth box?

Kayla got a new video game. She scored 2 points on the first level, 3 points on the second level, 5 points on the third level, 8 points on the fourth level, and 12 points on the fifth level. If this pattern continues, how many points will Kayla score on the sixth level?

Last year, Springtown Hardware ordered 3 hammers in June, 4 hammers in July, 6 hammers in August, and 9 hammers in September. If this pattern continues, how many hammers will the store order in October?

Jared owns a hardware store and is looking over his past orders. Jared's hardware store ordered 5 power drills in January, 6 power drills in February, 8 power drills in March, and 11 power drills in April. If this pattern continues, how many power drills will the store order in May?
Karlene read 3 pages on Tuesday, 6 pages on Wednesday, 12 pages on Thursday, 24 pages on Friday, and 48 pages on Saturday. If this pattern continues, how many pages will Karlene read on Sunday?

The teacher's helper was putting cookies onto plates. He put 5 cookies on the first plate, 7 cookies on the second plate, 10 cookies on the third plate, 14 cookies on the fourth plate, and 19 cookies on the fifth plate. If this pattern continues, how many cookies will the helper put on the sixth plate?
